methods.name: SCAN — Scientific Content Analysis
methods.body: Linguistic structure analysis: unexpected shifts, missing affect, altered time order, extraneous detail, passive distancing. Trained analysts; not single-cue proof.

methods.name: CBCA — Criteria-Based Content Analysis
methods.body: Structured credibility criteria for statements; used in some European jurisdictions.

methods.name: Polygraph (psychophysiological arousal)
methods.body: Measures GSR, BP, respiration under questioning. Arousal ≠ lie. Generally inadmissible in US federal criminal trials (Daubert).

methods.name: Ekman microexpression leakage
methods.body: Fleeting universal affect; training improves detection modestly; context-dependent.

methods.name: Reid technique behavioral cues
methods.body: Behavioral symptom analysis during accusatory interrogation — high false-confession risk.

methods.name: Voice stress analysis (VSA)
methods.body: Fundamental frequency perturbation claims; weak scientific support for courtroom use.

methods.name: Hostess 7 computational corroboration
methods.body: 94% noise / 6% truth filter. Cross-check claim against local files, QA GREEN, infinite drive index, git HEAD, hash verification. truth_score floor 30.

methods.name: NLP inconsistency heuristics
methods.body: Absolute language, credibility appeals, hearsay without source, confidence mismatch, long claims without evidence anchors.

methods.name: OSINT triangulation
methods.body: Independent public sources, archived pages, WHOIS, metadata vs content, timeline alignment.

methods.name: Digital forensics + hash chain
methods.body: SHA-256 verification, write-blocked imaging, chain of custody, log correlation UTC.

methods.name: Multimodal baseline deviation
methods.body: Compare speech rate, pause pattern, gesture rate under low-stakes vs high-stakes topics.

methods.name: Bayesian claim fusion
methods.body: Combine independent evidence channels with base-rate priors; output posterior deception risk.

methods.name: LLM self-consistency probing
methods.body: Re-ask claim variants; measure semantic drift, contradiction density, and evidence citation stability across paraphrases.

methods.name: Multimodal deception fusion (video+audio+text)
methods.body: Joint embedding of face, voice, transcript; calibrated on labeled datasets; human review gate.

methods.name: Blockchain / signed attestation trails
methods.body: Timestamped signed statements; detect retroactive edits; not truth alone — provenance only.

methods.name: Knowledge-graph contradiction mining
methods.body: Entity-relationship graph over claims; flag cycles, impossible timelines, mutual exclusivity.

methods.name: Federated lie-detection benchmarks
methods.body: Privacy-preserving cross-site calibration; reduces overfit to single lab polygraph datasets.

methods.name: Neuroimaging deception markers (fMRI/EEG)
methods.body: Laboratory signal patterns; not portable field lie detection; ethical and consent barriers.

disclaimer: Lie detection methods are educational. No method alone proves deception. Corroborate with independent evidence. Owner reviews all bad-person flags.
